caption: The drawing features a centrally positioned, elongated, robed figure in light gray, with a pale face and hands visible. The figure’s face has a serene expression with closed lips and arched eyebrows, and the head is covered by a smooth veil in the same gray tone as the robe, with a slightly darker shading on the shoulders. The figure is holding a golden-yellow circular object at chest level, radiating concentric halos of yellow light. A vertical golden line descends from the object, ending in a string of yellow beads that reach near the feet. The lower part of the robe is composed of vertical, parallel segments with subtle shadowing. The figure stands on a platform with concentric, wavy blue and green horizontal lines. The background is an arch filled with a gradient from pale blue at the bottom to a deeper blue at the top, within which are six yellow stars distributed across the upper half. The top of the arch is decorated with a vine motif bearing green leaves and clusters of purple grapes. The remainder of the background is off-white, and the entire composition is contained within a rectangular outline.
title: Santa Clara de Asis
